concepts.proposed_markdown: For Classic partner-platform PCI questionnaire onboarding, the 2026-09-15 Hop v6 API Explorer page says its one-time `redirectUrl` must be used within 30 seconds, while the separately captured Classic partner guide says redirect within 15 seconds and describes a 30-minute session after redirect. These are conflicting link-window statements, not interchangeable limits; neither link issuance nor session entry proves PCI verification.
